methodology.populationDefinition: INE official municipal population workbook, 1 January 2023
methodology.selectionResult: Maximum city cap reached before the population coverage target.

limitations: Spain v1 uses the official INE population ranking but does not ingest a normalized national heritage point feed; landmark records are community-source candidates.
Wikidata coverage and classification vary by municipality, and five sparse cities require bounded OpenStreetMap fallback.
The top-100 cap reaches 46.49% rather than the 50% population target; 125 municipalities would be required.
